Vendored assets; no build step or CDN requests required.

Use dist/; lib/ contains the legacy Docsify 4 build.

Prism 1.30.0: prism-*.min.js
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/prismjs@1.30.0/components/
MIT license: PRISM-LICENSE.txt
Core markup, CSS, JavaScript and C-like grammars are provided by Docsify.
PHP requires markup-templating; keep script order in index.html.

Existing Markdown may contain remote images and external links.
Those references are independent of the local theme assets.
